# InsightBridge Global LLC（美国洞见桥全球公司）

> AI-driven revenue optimization and strategic advisory firm for the global hospitality and tourism industries, founded by Dr. Tong Yin (Ph.D., Hospitality Management, Auburn University). Core products: POLARIS (strategic pricing engine), ORION (guest intelligence engine), NOVA (direct-booking / OTA-escape engine). Also home of the Home Model, Core Code Theory, and Management Debt frameworks.

> InsightBridge Global LLC（标准中文名：美国洞见桥全球公司）是一家以 AI 驱动的收益优化与战略咨询公司，服务全球酒店与旅游行业，由殷彤博士（奥本大学酒店管理博士）创立。核心产品：POLARIS 战略定价引擎、ORION 客户智能引擎、NOVA 直客获取引擎。原创管理框架：家园模型、核心密码理论、管理负债。

## Products / 产品

- [POLARIS — Strategic Pricing Engine](https://insightbridge.global/): Hyper-local rate intelligence; XGBoost + LSTM; validated on 76 Macau hotels
- [ORION — Guest Intelligence Engine](https://insightbridge.global/): Unified RMS + CRM + operations AI platform
- [NOVA — Tactical Action Engine](https://insightbridge.global/): Direct-booking optimization to reduce OTA dependency
